tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gnam chos las rtsa gsum spyi'i gtor bsngos bzhugs so:1$0000300 ༁ྃ: thatha: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung me thod sgyed steng: bhandha'i nang du zag med bdud rtsi yi: gtor ma 'di nyid 'bul ba'i gnas rnams ni: pad 'byung sku lnga mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs mchod: gu ru zhi ba drag po bka' brgyad mchod: dgongs 'dus phur pa yi dam rgya mtsho mchod: ye shes mtsho rgyal rdo rje phag mo sogs: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams thams cad mchod par bgyi: dpal mgon ma ning shan pa dmar nag sogs: chos skyong bka' srung thams cad mchod par bgyi: rnam sras dzaṃ dmar dzaṃ lha nag po sogs: nor lha rgya mtshor gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: rdo rje legs pa drang srong chen po sogs: dam can rgya mtsho kun la mchod pa 'bul: bdag gi nad rigs kun zhi tshe bsod dpal: rgyas shing snang srid dbang du 'du bar mdzod: dgra bgegs log 'dren chos log dam nyams rnams: skad cig thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlags nas kyang: bdag gi bsam pa thams cad bsgrub tu gsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī dharma pā la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu hya: ྈྈྈ ྈ zhes pa sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum bya lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu la o rgyan rin po ches dngos su gsungs pa maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: gnam chos las rtsa gsum spyi yi skong ba rgyun khyer legs par bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈ ྈ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐: skong ba bya thabs 'di lta ste: hūm̐: thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang: bdug spos mar me dri chab dang: zhal zas rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs: sman gtor rakta glu gar mas: bla ma sku gsum thugs dam bskang: sku lnga mtshan brgyad thugs dam bskang: bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: gur drag bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs: yi dam rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: phag khros seng gsum mtsho rgyal sogs: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan sogs: rje 'bangs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: ma ning shan pa gza' bdud sogs: chos skyong bka' srung thugs dam bskang: rnam sras dzaṃ lha la sogs pa: nor lha kun gyi thugs dam bskang: de ltar thugs dam bskangs nas kyang: bdag gis bsam pa 'grub pa dang: zhi rgyas dbang drag 'grub par mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ gu hya: ྈྈྈྈ zhes pa bdag sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje rang lo bcu gsum pa bya lo nag pa zla ba'i bco brgyad la o rgyan rin po ches dngos su gsungs pa dge shing bkra shis par gyur cig// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: gnam chos las u pa rā tsa'i skong bshags bzhugs: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈ mchod pa 'bul nas 'di ltar brjod do: hūm̐: bcom ldan che ge la: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yis: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: zhes so: maṅga laṃ: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈ hūm̐: bcom ldan che ge la: 'khor ba'i ma rig 'khrul pa yis:

ma shes thugs dang 'gal gyur te: mthol lo bshags so sa ma ya: zhes brjod do: zhes pa 'di sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje rang lo bcu gcig ngo mthong tsam la o rgyan rin po ches gsungs te 'di spyi la sbyar chog: maṃklalabhilhi: che ge zhes par yi dam gang 'dod sbyar shes par gyis shig: 'o na rten 'brel legs po bsgrig shes dka' do bas/ de 'dra ma legs pa gang byung yang skyon med pa'i gdams pa o rgyan la zhus/ zhes zhus pas/ skong ba shlo ka gcig dang*/ bshags pa shlo ka gcig byung ba bdag gis thugs dam byas so// zhes a rā gas bris//
